neighbours.label: R or r split off right after an opening quotation mark ('“Richest', '“racketeering', ''Risafa'); other first letters in the same frames stay quiet
fire: The town was once called the “Richest Village in the valley.”
Reporters wrote of the “racketeering charges” against him.
Locals call the district 'Risalat' to this day.
Its title was “Romance of the Three Kingdoms” in that edition.
The firm calls it a “Revolutionary Design” in ads.
Police spoke of “rampant crime” in the area.
Critics called it a “rubbish plan” at the time.
They named the area 'Rusafa' after the old palace.
quiet: The town was once called the “Golden Village in the valley.”
Reporters wrote of the “bribery charges” against him.
Locals call the district 'Masalat' to this day.
Its title was “Tales of the Three Kingdoms” in that edition.
The firm calls it a “Modern Design” in ads.
Police spoke of “serious crime” in the area.
Critics called it a “foolish plan” at the time.
They named the area 'Mosul' after the old palace.

short: 'R' or 'r' right after an opening quote
notes: Card: 'R' x6, ' R' x5, ' r' x3, 'r' x2, '-r' x2, and French ' déf', ' pr', after an opening quote. Probe: “Richest 0.96, “racketeering 0.75, 'Risafa 0.33; “Golden 0.12, 'Musafa 0.07, no quote 0.16. I have not tested R without a quote mark in the same word.
